_note: Inputs for cost_model.py. PI-ResNet efficiencies are the frozen 0228 evaluations on the realistic ler populations (experiments/apjs_revision in the lensing_classification repo, branch apjs-revision-20261107; work_<CFG>/results/revision/efficiency_vs_fap.csv). Posterior-overlap numbers are from Barsode, Goyal & Ajith, arXiv:2412.01278 (PO2.0): 65% efficiency at a pairwise FAP of about 2e-6 for galaxy-lensed BBHs at O4 HLV sensitivity (Sec. III.2, abstract); detection = network S/N >= 8 with two detectors above 4, two images detected (App. D.3); the paper quotes no measured per-pair run time, only 'the promise of ... evaluation times of a few minutes' (Sec. I), a veto that removes about 40% of unlensed pairs 'within a second' (App. C), and about half a CPU-hour of parameter estimation per injection (App. D.4). PO2.0 includes the time-delay prior R^L_U (2412.01278 Eq. 11, App. B.4, C.1; Sec. III.2: arrival time and time delay 'add about 20-40% to the detection efficiency'). The reviewer's '54% at 1e-6' is not stated in any text; it matches a reading of the ROC of the superseded implementation in arXiv:2605.10333 (Barsode, 'BB plot'), App. A Fig. 6 (old ~0.55, new ~0.59 at 1e-6). Per-pair cost: 'a few minutes' (2412.01278 Sec. I; Fig. 14: ~10-20 s at 500 posterior samples, ~3 min at 1e4), '~10 CPU seconds' (arXiv:2510.23238 Sec. III.2), 'one to two orders of magnitude less' in the 2605.10333 implementation; none includes single-event PE. C_P_s is the PI-ResNet end-to-end serial cost per pair from the submitted manuscript. Configs ET_v3 / ET_v3_td (and O4_v3 / O4_v3_td once run) are the v3 rerun; their per-pair PI-ResNet cost is the measured CPU cost amortised over the catalogue (key 'cost'), and the per-pair table amortises the overlap's per-event PE over the catalogue named in 'catalogue'. Configs ET / O4 are the v2 rerun with the submitted C_P_s.

overlap.cost_note: 1 s: lower bracket (2605.10333 implementation, 1-2 orders below ~10 s); 10 s: arXiv:2510.23238 Sec. III.2; 60-300 s: 'a few minutes' in Sec. I of 2412.01278
overlap.pe_note: App. D.4 of 2412.01278: about half an hour per injection on one CPU core; real-event PE is costlier. Needed once per event before any overlap statistic can be formed; amortised over N-1 partners.
